messages:
maya: quick sync — customer Z is pushing for realtime embeddings: 10k qps, p99 <50ms. can we realistically promise that for Dedicated this quarter?

sam: ambitious. we need routing + reserved pools. also how many dims? 768 or 2048?

maya: they currently use 1536 dims. want stable SLA by EoQ.

liam: KV cache will be the blocker for p99 at that qps unless we do more aggressive prefetching + larger shard mem.

alex: quantization helps throughput but needs kernel support for 4-bit GEMM path for embed ops. current kernels are slow on small batch sizes.

nina: roll criteria? we should require canary p99 < 60ms and <1% regression on accuracy delta for a sample eval set.

sam: proposal: split into two tracks — (A) low-latency path (kernels + KV prefetch) and (B) cost-optimized path (quant + batching). ship A as alpha to customer Z, B later.

maya: ok. estimate effort? rough numbers pls.

liam: A = 4 sprint effort: KV sharding + prefetch heuristics + perf tests. B = 3 sprints: quant profiles + kernel bindings + CI.

alex: I can prototype a 4-bit path but need help from runtime to wire the fast GEMM. estimate 6 weeks for PoC.

nina: owners: liam on KV, alex on quant kernels, sam on routing & capacity. maya will lead customer comms + SLA draft.

ops-bot: deploy-canary: embedding-path-canary deployed to staging — p95 42ms, p99 72ms, throughput 6.5k qps (staging HW).

maya: staging numbers look promising but p99 is high. can we reduce tail by caching prefixes or prioritizing hot keys?

liam: yes, add hot-key prefix cache and async prefetch for top 10k vectors. that should pull p99 down ~15-25% based on sims.

sam: also consider routing small requests to pinned low-latency hosts to avoid queuing. will add policy prototype.

alex: note: quant introduces a small embedding drift. we need embedded-regression eval: run eval set and gate at <0.3% embedding-sim drop.

nina: agreed. launch criteria checklist draft:
- canary p95 < 50ms and p99 < 60ms on staging
- throughput >= 8k qps on prod-equivalent infra
- embedding sim loss < 0.3% on eval set
- SD of tail < 20ms across 95th->99th
- runbook and fallback (auto-route to non-quant model) in place

maya: timeline suggestion: start KV work now, prototype quant kernels in parallel, aim for alpha with customer in 8 weeks.

sam: need resource ask: 2 engs on KV, 1 eng on routing, 1 eng on kernel binding + 0.5 from infra for perf lab.

liam: will put a resource plan into the perf OKR doc.

alex: I'll mock up a kernel perf matrix and post it here by EOW.

nina: i'll author the launch checklist PR and include canary dashboards and eval harness links.

maya: next steps: owners add to roadmap board, set milestones, and sync Tues 10am. i'll loop in account team to manage expectations.

sam: +1. thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: note: alerting rule created: embedding-p99 > 85ms -> paging oncall.
